* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star II: Turbolift Walkway (Errata)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-11-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual18-Light/large/deathstariiturboliftwalkway.gif</code> as published 11 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual18-Light/large/deathstariiturboliftwalkway.gif holotable commit 6894629] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: If you have more than one character here, you must target one to be lost (cannot be prevented). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF at a larger size (745×534 → 1039×745 pixels) with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, which re-made 51 landscape card images that day; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name); it is the same card enlarged, with the same rounded transparent corners — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged. A visible (resolution) change, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
